mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a three-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which signals a contractionary economic trajectory and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 with a 2-month consecutive decline signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 and declining for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances despite INDPRO below 100.0 and declining for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST), indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages fails to predict positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% over a three-month period signals a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.3% signals a labor market contraction, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 0% change in 1 month and UNRATE > 4.3%
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE > 4.3% fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline for 6 consecutive months and HOUST < 1200.0
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 decline and HOUST < 1200.0 fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).
